source: modules.json (completion proxy = module score), dependencies.json (real dependency graph), impact.json (features/processes/risk), tasks.json (evidence-matched tasks)
disclaimer: No effort/velocity data exists in this pipeline, so no completion dates or durations are estimated here -- only real relationship counts (dependents, features, processes).

method.completionProxy: A module is considered 'incomplete' when modules.json score < 100. This score is the existing composite (architecture/tests/documentation/backend/frontend) quality score -- not a literal feature-completion percentage.
method.unblocks: direct = modules.dependedOnBy in dependencies.json; transitive = BFS over reverse edges of the real dependency graph
method.percentOfErp: (own features + transitive dependents' features) / impact.json coverage.totalFeaturePoints * 100
method.rankingRule: Incomplete modules sorted by transitiveUnblocks (desc), then by current score (asc) as tiebreak

relatedTasks: Review possible secrets in source files (40 real matches, excluding node_modules)
